verdict.rationale: The docs pack shows an extensive API reference (developers.openai.com/api/reference/...) and guides filled with code snippets (SDK install, tool calls, streaming, etc.) plus a maintained Cookbook of 'practical code examples' — evidence of a rich reference with example code, but nothing indicates the reference pages are actually interactive/runnable in-browser (e.g., a live playground or 'run' button embedded in docs), and the probe found no OpenAPI spec exposed for tooling. missing for 10: evidence of an in-page 'run this example' / interactive console, confirmation of a live playground integrated into the reference, and an accessible OpenAPI/spec file for programmatic exploration.
